authority: DERIVED — upstream SOT: GEBCO_2019 grid, published RF literature, transects.json registry

transect.distance_model: WGS84 Karney geodesic (geographiclib), control-point polyline; rounding 0.1 km
transect.sign_convention: elevation positive above datum; depth below datum positive-down in km panels
transect.azimuth_note: dog-leg — not a single azimuth; not latitude-monotonic

surface.sampling: nearest-neighbour at ~1 km spacing along the polyline
surface.class: OBS (grid values) — NOT a surveyed seismic line

trough.note: Sabah Trough floor; anchors topography only — does NOT establish a rift or intrusion

summit.status: OPEN — cause not established (grid sampling vs geodetic summit); profile is NOT forced through the summit

latitude_6N.method: linear latitude interpolation between control points on Karney chainage

cornwell_claim.text: Cornwell et al. 2025 place a crust/mantle domain transition at ~6.0°N, with Mt Kinabalu on that boundary
cornwell_claim.verified: NOT re-verified this pass — publisher full text blocked (403); as read by 333-AGI 2026-10-26
cornwell_claim.firewall: geographic proximity of the 6.0°N line and the NSPW southern limit is NOT evidence of a causal link; the crossing does NOT fix Model B's km endpoints

picks.projection_method: station coincides with registered control point 5 (Kota Kinabalu coast)

whisker.note: H-kappa stacking ±2.5 km (95% CI), Sidek et al. 2016 — per-station published uncertainty

picks.source: Sidek et al. 2016 (doi:10.7186/bgsm62201607); Madon et al. 2025
picks.note: 32.8 ± 2.5 km at the KK coast; ledger CL-MOHO-KMY-328; decides only the ~430 km domain (Fresnel ~20–30 km)

picks.projection_method: closest point on control-point polyline (per-segment equirectangular); cross-track = WGS84 geodesic

whisker.note: published RF vertical resolution band, drawn ±2 km uniformly; NOT a per-station published uncertainty (not digitised)

not_plotted.reason: MetMalaysia station — no FDSN coordinates; the 60 km crustal maximum cannot be georeferenced onto this transect
88 km off-line; projecting would manufacture a constraint
>50 km off-line; 'Moho deepens >40 km beneath SBC4'

no_constraint_zones_km.reason: no RF stations offshore this transect (Dangerous Grounds / trough / DWFTB); first on-line control is KMY at the coast (km 430.0)
eastern Sabah stations lie >50 km off-line

moho.interpolation_policy: NO interpolated or decorative Moho bridge across unconstrained intervals

contested.claim_1: Gilligan et al. 2026: 24–25 km Moho (SBC6/SBC5) — central Sabah among thinnest crust
contested.claim_2: Cornwell et al. 2025: no typical Moho in central Sabah; the 23–24 km feature is a mid-crustal discontinuity above a WSW-dipping LVZ at 34–38 km
contested.resolution: both claims drawn side by side; neither picked

slab_remnant.width_semantics: published width of the imaged discontinuity (Cornwell et al. 2025 Key Points); NOT automatically the along-transect extent — the drawn 455–545 km window is an approximate along-line projection (mid-width)
slab_remnant.apparent_dip: not derived — dog-leg projection; true dip never read off the exaggerated graphic
slab_remnant.source: Cornwell et al. 2025, JGR Solid Earth 130(11) e2025JB031466 (open access; verified 2026-10-27)

lab.source: Greenfield et al. 2022, via Cornwell et al. 2025
lab.rendering: dashed reference line with own evidence status — not a precisely measured uniform boundary

dwftb.source: Wu, McClay & de Vera 2020, Geosphere 16(1):329–356 (open access; figure geometry not digitised)
dwftb.forbidden: no invented thrust dips, detachments, fault spacing, vergence, shortening magnitude or balanced geometry
dwftb.accepts: metadata will accept future verified numeric constraints (dips, spacing) without schema change

kl2_project_calibration.entity: KL2 Kinabalu Deepwater Project (8-Key-Line Grid & Well Calibration Sector)
kl2_project_calibration.subsurface_wells_calibrated: Tepat-1, Pekaka, Limbayong, Wells A/B/D (internal lane T-KL2-INTERNAL)
kl2_project_calibration.note: Deepwater NW Sabah fold-thrust belt & slope calibration sector (Sabah Trough to shelf edge). Wells and local seismic horizons are calibrated in internal project lane (T-KL2-INTERNAL); public transect T-KIN-XS-833 provides the regional boundary conditions.

hinz_schluter_1985.status: RETIRED — acquisition/interpretation route stopped (F13 2026-10-26); citation retained as history; no geometry drawn from it

domains.family: H4 thermal plumbing (inherited rift axis / possible intrusions)
domains.basis: trough floor 3.02 km at km 242 (GEBCO, OBS) — the thinned axis the hypothesis needs
domains.derivation: model window centred on the trough segment; endpoints are modelling choices, NOT literature picks
domains.status: UNTESTED working hypothesis; no proven intrusion geometry; no ridge-push claim

domains.basis: Morley et al. 2023 (Geosphere 19(1):291, verified 2026-10-27): 'The NSPW is a distinctive unit that is confined to northern Sabah. Passing into southern Sabah, the NSPW is absent.'
domains.derivation: northern-Sabah scope mapped onto the line's trough+outboard segment; endpoints NOT established by the 6.0°N crossing
domains.status: PUBLISHED (strongest empirical maturity); northern Sabah scope only

domains.basis: DG collision → underthrusting; proto-SCS subduction terminated ~21 Ma (Gilligan et al. preprint abstract, eartharxiv 5899, verified 2026-10-27)
domains.derivation: outboard DWFTB + shelf segment; interpretive geometry — not locally imaged on this line
domains.status: CLASSIC interpretation; collision onset ≠ underthrusting onset ≠ DRU surface age (kept separate)

domains.family: H3 mantle state (slab remnant) + separate H1 gravity subclaim
domains.basis: Cornwell et al. 2025: 45–55 km discontinuity, 75–100 km wide, gently W-dipping
domains.derivation: approximate along-line projection of the imaged discontinuity
domains.status: PARTLY OBSERVED; the gravity-tectonics subclaim is a separate layer with its own shelf domain (km ~373–430) — the slab window does NOT bound shallow gravity deformation

rendering_policy.outside_support_domain: not drawn; marked UNKNOWN/hatched where a gap must be visible
rendering_policy.domain_endpoints: no vertical geological walls at endpoints; fading/hatched truncation
rendering_policy.overlap: domain overlaps are allowed and drawn — they are not mutual exclusion claims
rendering_policy.unknown_vs_missing: UNKNOWN regions are hatched and labelled; missing rendering is a defect
